The menu

    Prices come straight from the booking system. Where a price depends on length or barber you'll see the range, and Square confirms it before you book. Kids' cuts are cash, please.

    Not sure which fade to book?

    It comes down to where the fade starts. Pick the line that matches and it goes straight into your booking.

    • At the skinSkin Fade · foil shaver · $55–$60 · 40 min+
    • At zeroZero Fade · clipper, no guard · $55 · 30 min+
    • On a guardFade Cut · not from zero or skin · from $45 · 30 min+
    • No fadeClassic Cut · clipper sides, scissors on top · $44 · 20 min

    The shop

    “Every barber earns by their own work, so they'll give you the perfect haircut every single time.”

    The shop, on Instagram

    Nobody here is on the clock to rush you. Every barber works to the same standard of care and detail, with chipboard walls, gilt mirrors, gold capes and a seven-year-old Wahl Magic Clip that hasn't slowed down.

    If your usual barber is booked out, choose Any Staff and take the next free chair.

    You might have met the team at Hop Temple, where they ran a barber station for the Ballarat Beard Comp.
